title: Input catalogue of JASMINE (GCS window)
summary: Version 4 published September 24, 2026 by the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan. Contains 139,279 sources in the nominal JASMINE Galactic Center Survey window, with Gaia crossmatches, propagated positions/errors, and unified astrometry.
semantic_integrity: This is an input catalogue and astrometric preparation layer, not a completed JASMINE science result. Propagated uncertainties must remain distinct from future measurements.

title: New mammal remains from the Pondaung Formation (late middle Eocene, Myanmar)
summary: GBIF registered this Plazi treatment on September 22, 2026. The 2026 paper describes several mammal remains from the Kyargan locality in the Pondaung Formation, expanding the previously reported primate and ungulate record.
semantic_integrity: The digitized treatment preserves taxonomic interpretation; specimen identity, stratigraphic context, and later phylogenetic interpretation should remain separable evidence layers.

title: Hydrangea medogensis (Hydrangeaceae), a new species from Xizang (Tibet), China
summary: GBIF registered the Plazi treatment on September 10, 2026. The species was established from field surveys, herbarium specimens, morphological characters and molecular phylogenetic analyses; the dataset provides machine-readable treatment endpoints.
semantic_integrity: Species delimitation is supported by integrated evidence described in the underlying publication; GBIF registration itself is not independent validation.

title: iNaturalist Research-grade Observations Marine Subset, Version 2.0
summary: Published September 1, 2026 through OBIS and the Marine Biological Association. Version 2.0 contains 11,568,267 submitted occurrences, 11,555,808 accepted occurrences and 37,331 taxa across 33,819 species. OBIS quality flags explicitly expose coordinate, taxonomic and marine-status issues.
semantic_integrity: Research-grade status is a workflow classification, not a guarantee of perfect identification or geospatial accuracy. Preserve OBIS quality flags rather than filtering them away.

title: Simulated atmospheric microplastics for Reduced global atmospheric microplastic emissions from size-harmonized observations
summary: Published September 23, 2026. Open raw outputs from GEOS-Chem simulations of atmospheric microplastic emissions, transport and deposition, associated with Hough et al. (2026). The dataset is useful as a reproducible model-output layer alongside observation-derived emission constraints.
semantic_integrity: Model output is not direct observation. Keep parameterization, forcing, observational constraints and simulated quantities distinct when correlating with measured atmospheric microplastics.

title: Inter-comparison of low-cost sensors' measurements for indoor air quality applications
summary: Published September 13, 2026. The dataset contains measurements used to compare low-cost sensors for indoor air-quality applications, providing a calibration and uncertainty-comparison opportunity between inexpensive and reference instrumentation.
semantic_integrity: Sensor agreement must not be treated as equivalence without accounting for calibration, drift, response time, environmental sensitivity and reference-instrument uncertainty.

title: Laboratory-confirmed influenza cases in Germany
summary: Robert Koch Institute dataset version dated September 24, 2026. It provides state-level laboratory-confirmed influenza reports under Germany's Infection Protection Act, stratified by age groups and intended for epidemiological assessment.
semantic_integrity: Administrative surveillance counts follow a legal case/reporting framework; they should remain distinct from infection prevalence, clinical severity, or causal inference.

title: COVID-19 hospitalizations in Germany
summary: Robert Koch Institute dataset version dated September 24, 2026. It provides current reported hospitalizations and incidence measures plus model-based nowcasts for delayed reports, intended to better characterize health-system burden.
semantic_integrity: Reported observations and nowcast estimates are different evidence classes and must not be merged without preserving their uncertainty and methodological provenance.

title: COVID-19 deaths in Germany
summary: Robert Koch Institute dataset version dated September 24, 2026, providing daily updated COVID-19 mortality information aggregated by reporting date, age group and federal state, with a case-fatality component.
semantic_integrity: Reporting-date aggregation and case-fatality measures are analytical constructs; preserve the underlying reporting framework and denominator definitions.

title: A curated and integrated dataset for exploring global bee-plant interactions
summary: A 2026 Scientific Data resource refining a subset of the Global Biotic Interactions database around bee-plant interactions, updating taxonomy and adding geography, endemism and human-use metadata. It provides a structured basis for pollination-network and ethnobotanical cross-correlation.
semantic_integrity: The integrated dataset is curated from heterogeneous interaction records; source-level evidence and taxonomic provenance should remain recoverable beneath aggregated interaction edges.
